title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Tue Nov 24)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Tue, Nov 24

Monday pressers, rivalry week: Vanderbilt's 5-star freshman QB is expected to play through a wrist injury, Michigan's lead back is a close call for Ohio State, Syracuse is on its backup QB, and Indiana hasn't picked a starter 🧵👇

🩹 JARED CURTIS | Vanderbilt | FR, 5⭐ | #66 QB

He grabbed his wrist and missed one play against Florida. Clark Lea doesn't sound worried about Tennessee week:

"I expect him to practice. I expect him to play."

(via Vanderbilt On SI)

❓ JORDAN MARSHALL | Michigan | JR, 4⭐ | #42 RB

Kyle Whittingham on Ohio State: "It's going to be close" (via Wolverines Wire).

🩹 Malachi Nelson | Syracuse | SR, 5⭐ | #193 QB starts vs Notre Dame. Steve Angeli is out (via SB Nation).

❓ JOSH HOOVER | Indiana | SR, 3⭐ | #47 QB

No starter named for Purdue. Curt Cignetti: "Both quarterbacks will take reps with the ones" (via Indiana On SI).

🩹 Nick Marsh | Indiana | JR, 4⭐ | #16 WR: no update Monday (via 247Sports).

Who worries you most? 👇
